reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that orchestrates LLM provider fallback chains, retrying eligible failures on configured providers and exposing local Web UI configuration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LLM provider 回退链，在符合条件的请求失败时按配置切换到备用 provider 和模型。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with configurable LLM provider fallback chains that switch eligible failed requests to alternate providers and models.

capabilities: Routes failed LLM requests to configured provider and model fallbacks
Retries requests for configured failure conditions
Tracks in-process failure counts and cooldown state
Provides a Web UI and local endpoint for fallback configuration
Persists fallback settings to the harness settings file
